verdict.rationale: GitHub's own materials show dependency remediation (updating vulnerable dependencies with supported fixes for breaking changes) and secret scanning (detecting, preventing and remediating leaked secrets, with push protection blocking active secrets). Static analysis is only implied, through Copilot Autofix and security campaigns that reduce application vulnerabilities, and nothing in the pack shows dynamic scanning, so the story's four-way consolidation is only about half evidenced. Missing for 10: any dynamic (DAST) scanning capability, explicit documentation of a static analysis/code scanning engine, evidence that these scanners are managed together in one place, independent or hands-on corroboration.
